# Avenquell Studio

> Creative and marketing studio in Charleston, SC. We diagnose what is broken in a
> brand's visuals, ads and measurement before anyone spends more on production.
> Direction before production. Diagnosis before spend.

Avenquell works in three stages: a paid diagnostic that states the problem in writing,
one-off projects scoped from that diagnosis, and monthly systems for brands that need
ongoing output. Every price is published. Human review before anything ships.

## Pages

- [Home](https://avenquell.com/): what the studio does and how an engagement starts
- [Method](https://avenquell.com/method/): six steps, two client approval gates
- [Standard](https://avenquell.com/standard/): what we refuse to deliver, and why
- [Services](https://avenquell.com/services/): every service by stage and vertical
- [Pricing](https://avenquell.com/pricing/): all prices, terms, guarantee and credit rules
- [Work](https://avenquell.com/work/): concept studies showing the method in practice
- [Concept Study 01](https://avenquell.com/work/cs01/): premium home fragrance launch
- [Contact](https://avenquell.com/contact/): inquiry form

## Diagnostics

- Premium Visual Audit — $1,500 (visual review) / $2,500 (plus performance read), 3 business days
- Ad Diagnostic — $3,500, 5 business days. Includes 3-5 ad concepts. Named cause or refund
- Marketing Research — $7,500 (2 weeks) / $12,500 (4 weeks)

## Projects

- Conversion Foundation — $6,500 / $9,500 with server-side tracking
- Campaign Build — $2,500 per channel
- Website — $9,500 / $14,000 in regulated categories
- Strategy & Positioning — from $5,000
- Launch Creative Package — from $6,500, 2-4 weeks

## Monthly

- Monthly Creative Content System — from $9,500/mo, two-month minimum
- Paid Media Management — $3,500/mo first channel, +$1,500 each additional
- Content Plan & Scripts — from $5,000/mo
- Analytics & Reporting — $2,500/mo
- Quantitative & Segment Analytics — from $5,000 one-time
- Full Creative & Strategy System — $12,500/mo (one segment) / $18,000/mo (two to three)

## Good to know

- Based in Charleston, South Carolina. Works with brands worldwide
- Verticals: DTC fashion, beauty and skincare, boutique hospitality, wellness and supplements
- No annual contracts, no platform fee, no prepayment for the year. Cancel with 30 days notice
- Ad budgets go directly to the platforms. All ad and analytics accounts are opened in the
  client's own name
- Diagnostics work from client exports and screenshots. No account access required
- The studio does not guarantee sales, ROAS, followers or bookings, and says so on the site
